claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of system events and conditions, including a thermal and memory pressure state check, a location icon activation, a system wake call, a network analytics journal record drop, a Safari safe browsing update delay, and a network access denial for a process.
The events occurred on two different Macs, calvisitor-10-105-163-202 and authorMacBook-Pro, with the latter experiencing a system wake call and a network analytics issue.
The system is also experiencing network activity, including an mDNS response.
